title: Advanced Python I — Modules, Comprehensions, Generators, Lambdas
blurb: Modules, compact comprehensions, iterators and lazy generator pipelines, lambda/map/filter/sorted, virtual environments and command-line arguments. Green-light sections follow the lecture slides.

title: Advanced Python II — Decorators, Errors, Types, Context Managers
blurb: Make code robust and self-describing: decorators, exception handling for dirty data, type hints, dataclasses, with-blocks.

title: NumPy — Arrays and Vectorised Computation
blurb: Lists and arrays, indexing and slicing, views and copies, universal functions, aggregations and axis, broadcasting, masks, fancy indexing, sorting, plus random numbers and linear algebra. Follows Chapter 2 of the textbook.

title: Pandas I — Tables, Selection and Cleaning
blurb: Series and DataFrames, loc and iloc, masks, index alignment, missing data, text columns and hierarchical indexing. Follows the first half of Chapter 3 of the textbook.

title: Pandas II — Combining, Grouping, Pivoting and Time Series
blurb: concat and merge, split-apply-combine with groupby, pivot tables, dates and resampling, query, and the Project Stage 1 structure. Follows the second half of Chapter 3 of the textbook.

title: JSON — Parsing, Nested Data, APIs
blurb: Serialise and parse JSON, walk nested structures, flatten API-style records into DataFrames and back.

title: Scikit-learn — Preprocessing, Models, Evaluation
blurb: The estimator API, train/test split, scaling and encoding, a pipeline, classification and regression metrics.
